target_primitive: Search and categories with optional shop/sort/status controls
shared_relation: A goal requires a subset of available controls
break_point: Frequently needed options become hidden or active filters are invisible
test_condition: Users can browse and find filters without coaching; active filters remain evident

target_primitive: Ordering prerequisites and optional voucher explanation
shared_relation: Required conditions constrain action; conditional explanations support a subset of users
proposed_method: Visible eligibility with optional supplementary help
break_point: Eligibility or payment requirements are placed inside collapsed help
test_condition: Visitors correctly identify who can order before checkout

target_primitive: Homepage process outline with specific help links
shared_relation: An overview predicts relevance before deeper reading
break_point: Generic headings or an overlong outline obscure the next action
test_condition: Visitors explain the process and find pickup/voucher help unassisted

target_primitive: Transfer payment then wait for confirmation then collect
shared_relation: A completed action enables the next action
break_point: Creating an order is mistaken for successful payment
test_condition: Participants distinguish held price/order creation/payment confirmation/pickup

shared_relation: A choice depends on comparing multiple attributes together
test_condition: Participants compare meals without repeatedly opening and closing sections
